[
  {
    "i": 0,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 27.11, "unit": "%", "anchor": "a PCE of 27.11% (certified 26.3%)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.3, "unit": "%", "anchor": "a PCE of 27.11% (certified 26.3%)"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Photovoltages of 1.30, 1.38, and 1.42 V were achieved for 1.68, 1.79, and 1.85 eV bandgap perovskite solar cells respectively, all exceeding 90% of their thermodynamic limits.", "anchor": "These resulted in 1.30, 1.38, and 1.42 V photovoltages for 1.68, 1.79, and 1.85 eV bandgap perovskite solar cells, respectively, all exceeding 90% of their thermodynamic limits.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Monolithic perovskite-organic tandem solar cells were demonstrated by integrating wide-bandgap perovskite with an organic subcell.", "anchor": "We also demonstrate high-efficiency monolithic tandem solar cells by integrating the optimized wide-bandgap perovskite solar cell with an organic subcell to achieve a PCE of 27.11% (certified 26.3%).", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "3D/2D-amidinium perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.4, "unit": "%", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 25.4, "unit": "%", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1.1, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Devices maintained >95% of initial efficiency after 1100 hours of continuous 1-sun operation at 85°C.", "anchor": "maintain >95% of their initial efficiency after 1100 hours of continuous 1-sun operation at 85°C.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "A controllable 1D-to-2D structural transition strategy was introduced by tuning multivalent amidinium ligand conformation.", "anchor": "we introduce a controllable one- to two-dimensional (1D-to-2D) structural transition strategy by systematically tuning ligand conformation, thereby modulating hydrogen bonding, π-π stacking, and basicity", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.6, "unit": "%", "anchor": "n-i-p perovskite solar cells to achieve a PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.5%)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "n-i-p perovskite solar cells to achieve a PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.5%)"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-3",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Devices retained 98.6% and 97.2% of initial PCEs after 1617 hours MPP tracking and 5280 hours ambient storage respectively.", "anchor": "the devices retain 98.6 and 97.2% of their initial PCEs after 1617 hours of continuous operation under maximum power point tracking [ISOS-L-3 protocol, 85°C, 60% relative humidity (RH)] and 5280 hours of ambient storage (ISOS-D-1 protocol, room temperature, 10% RH).", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Molecular press annealing with 2-pyridylethylamine enabled real-time healing of iodine vacancies during annealing.", "anchor": "a 2-pyridylethylamine film is thermally and pressure-bonded to the perovskite surface. Real-time healing of iodine vacancies occurred during annealing", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "none",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The resulting TiO 2 @SnO 2 p-MPSCs achieve a well improved champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 22.5%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.1, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "enabling a PCE of 22.5% and 18.8% for 0.1-cm 2 and 57.33-cm 2 devices"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Encapsulated devices retained 90% efficiency after 2000 hours MPP tracking at 55±5°C.", "anchor": "encapsulated devices exhibit good operational stability, with 90% efficiency retained after 2000-h maximum power point tracking under continuous illumination at 55 ± 5 °C.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "18.8% PCE was achieved in 57.33 cm² minimodules demonstrating scalability.", "anchor": "The bilayer mp-ETL also demonstrates scalability with 18.8% PCE achieved in 57.33-cm 2 minimodules.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "A TiO2@SnO2 bilayer mp-ETL was developed via low-temperature chemical bath deposition on the triple mesoporous scaffold.", "anchor": "By performing tailored chemical bath deposition of the preformed triple mesoporous scaffold of TiO 2 ETL/ZrO 2 spacer/carbon electrode rather than the mp-TiO 2 alone, the conformal SnO 2 coating is formed without experiencing high-temperature annealing suffering", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CsPbIxBr3-x",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 12.16, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized device (5 mg/mL IDA) delivers a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 12.16%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Modified devices retained over 82% of initial efficiency after 1000 hours of continuous simulated sunlight irradiation.", "anchor": "retaining over 82% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous simulated sunlight irradiation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Hysteresis was reduced from 0.024 to 0.011 with IDA modification.", "anchor": "the modified devices exhibit markedly reduced hysteresis (from 0.024 to 0.011)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 17.93, "unit": "%", "anchor": "incorporating 2 vol% CM NCs into PSCs achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 17.93%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "CeO2@MoS2 nanocomposites were incorporated as an interfacial buffer layer into a NiOX/MeO-2PACz HTL.", "anchor": "hydrothermally synthesized CeO2@MoS2 nanocomposites (CM NCs) were incorporated as an interfacial buffer layer into a NiOX/MeO-2PACz HTL.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Mo sites in MoS2 interact with NiOX, modulating the Ni2+/Ni3+ ratio and reducing interfacial trap density.", "anchor": "Mo sites in MoS2 interact with NiOX, modulating the Ni2+/Ni3+ ratio and reducing the interfacial trap density.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CH3NH3PbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 24.2, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The optimized HNW structure achieved a notable power conversion efficiency of 24.2%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "An optical short-circuit current density of 29.53 mA/cm² was achieved via FDTD simulation of the hexagonal nanowire structure.", "anchor": "a higher optical short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 29.53 mA/cm2.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "The rotational symmetry of the HNW configuration yielded polarization-independent absorbance under TE and TM illumination.", "anchor": "The rotational symmetry of the HNW configuration yielded polarization-independent absorbance under both TE and TM illumination across the visible and near-infrared spectra.", "evidence_type": "simulation"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "2D/3D perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.82, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The optimized device achieves a champion PCE of 25.82%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-2",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "ATAA upshifts the valence band maximum by 0.12 eV, optimizing interfacial energy alignment and facilitating charge extraction.", "anchor": "ATAA upshifts the valence band maximum (VBM) by 0.12 eV, optimizing interfacial energy alignment and facilitating charge extraction.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained 91% of initial PCE after 1200 hours of MPP tracking under continuous illumination.", "anchor": "retaining 91% of the initial PCE after 1 200 h of maximum power point tracking (ISOS‐L‐2 protocol) under continuous illumination.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "A large-area device of 1 cm² maintained a high PCE of 24.68%.", "anchor": "large‐area device (1 cm 2 ) maintains a high PCE of 24.68%.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "FAPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized inverted PSCs delivering a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of nearly 26%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The best device achieved JSC of 25.77 mA/cm², VOC of 1.18 V, and FF of 85.62%.", "anchor": "a J SC of 25.77 mA cm −2 , a V OC of 1.18 V, and an FF of 85.62%.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "3,5-difluoropyridine additive modulated crystallization yielding reduced defect density and suppressed non-radiative recombination.", "anchor": "3,5‐difluoropyridine (DFPy) additive effectively modulates the crystallization process, yielding perovskite films with reduced defect density, suppressed non‐radiative recombination, and enhanced phase stability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "FAPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.50, "unit": "%", "anchor": "VPD‐modified PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency of 25.50%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "VPD simultaneously coordinated with Pb2+ ions and polymerized in situ, reprogramming tensile strain into compressive stress and directing oriented (100) crystal growth.", "anchor": "VPD simultaneously coordinates with Pb 2+ ions and polymerizes in situ into a cross‐linked network, suppressing PbI 2 formation, reprogramming tensile strain into compressive stress, and directing oriented (100) crystal growth.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained 95% of initial performance after 500 hours of continuous operation.", "anchor": "retain 95% of their initial performance after 500 h of continuous operation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "CsPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 21.13, "unit": "%", "anchor": "boost the device power conversion efficiency (PCE) to 21.13%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A solid water-insoluble PbSO4 layer was formed in situ via sodium ethylxanthate to block moisture ingress.", "anchor": "a solid water‐insoluble PbSO 4 layer is in situ formed to block the moisture ingress.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices showed >95% PCE retention after 3800 hours in N2.", "anchor": "the device stability is also improved with >95% PCE retention after 3,800 h in N 2.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25, "unit": "%", "anchor": "With an optimized interlayer, PSCs reach 25%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Ol-CzRAA interlayer increased breakdown voltage by nearly two orders of magnitude.", "anchor": "devices incorporating Ol‐CzRAA exhibit a breakdown voltage increased by nearly two orders of magnitude", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained 83% of initial efficiency after 100 hours at −1 V reverse bias and 80% after 500 hours continuous illumination.", "anchor": "retain 83% of their initial efficiency after 100 h at −1 V reverse bias, and maintain 80% after 500 h continuous illumination.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Moderate reverse bias drives rapid formation of electrically insulating NiI2 interlayer together with a Ni–O–Pb intermediate at the NiOx/perovskite interface.", "anchor": "moderate reverse bias drives the rapid formation of an electrically insulating NiI 2 interlayer together with a Ni–O–Pb intermediate", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  }
]
